function.description: Animate a shot into a video. Takes a .shot asset (pre-composed first frame with characters/scene/objects) and adds camera movement and action to produce a cinematic video clip.

shot.description: File ID of a .shot file (the pre-composed first frame and its metadata)

prompt.description: Motion direction — what moves in the shot. If omitted, the shot's own action description is used.

references.description: Comma-separated file IDs of additional reference images to guide the motion (e.g. a character the subject interacts with that wasn't in the starting frame, or a visual style reference). The shot's first frame is already used as the start image.

model.description: Video model. Default to veo-3.1-lite (cheapest). Use veo-3.1-fast for higher quality or when the user asks. Use veo-3.1 only when the user explicitly wants maximum quality.

resolution.description: Output resolution. veo-3.1-lite supports only 720p and 1080p.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds. 4 and 6 are only available at 720p. For 1080p or 4k, use 8.
